nodes.description: Perform the stated touch screen calibration procedure and save and exit.

attributes.description: Perform the stated touch screen calibration procedure and save and exit.
attributes.instruction_text: Power down the cutting system. Place finger on the upper left corner of the touch screen as Shown. While holding finger on the screen, turn ON the main power switch located on the back of the diagnostic control cabinet. Remove finger after the "Power On Setup" screen appears. Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen to begin calibrating. Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the cross as shown. The cross will reappear in the lower right corner. Press the center of the cross. Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to complete calibration.
attributes.name: Calibrate the touch screen

solvent and blow clean with air.

plates are level. Assemble stop discs. Reinstall operator
side cover onto gantry.

electrical interference traceable to Firestar f-Series lasers.
System Maintenance

Measures to Correct Interference
If you suspect that your Firestar laser interferes with other
equipment, take the following steps to minimize this inter-
ference:
1) Use shielded cables to and from the equipment that is
experiencing interference problems.
2) Ensure that the Firestar laser is properly grounded to the
same electrical potential as the equipment or system it is
connected to.

Cleaning of Airbrush
The air brush stylus has been designed for minimum main-
tenance. The leather packing washers should be lubricated
once a month with light oil. Old packing washers cause
leakage of air or fluid. Flush clean solvent through the fluid
passage of the stylus and wipe off the outside with clean
solvent. Never leave the entire stylus immersed in solvent.
Dirty spray caps and tips should be cleaned by soaking in
solvent and blow clean with air.

manufacturers of laser products to provide an indication of

degree of hazard; to require both user and manufacturer to
establish procedures so that proper precautions are adopted;

to improve control of laser radiation through protective fea-

Description of Problem:
The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message
“Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch
Screen.  When pressing NEXT on the keypad, the machine
will continue to cut where it left off.  This is typically caused
by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.
ev_8738cf22f376060ff6538b485e55:
Troubleshooting:
1.Check stop disc activation. The stop discs should not
activate by a slight touch or vibration. They should activate
only when moved by minimum pressure. Remove gantry
side cover. Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger
to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease
activation pressure.

The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message
“Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch
Screen.  When pressing NEXT on the keypad, the machine
will continue to cut where it left off.  This is typically caused
by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.
ev_8738cf22f376060ff6538b485e55:
Troubleshooting:
1.Check stop disc activation. The stop discs should not
activate by a slight touch or vibration. They should activate
only when moved by minimum pressure. Remove gantry
side cover. Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger
to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease
activation pressure.

locator.quote:
Cleaning of Airbrush
The air brush stylus has been designed for minimum main-
tenance. The leather packing washers should be lubricated
once a month with light oil. Old packing washers cause
leakage of air or fluid. Flush clean solvent through the fluid
passage of the stylus and wipe off the outside with clean
solvent. Never leave the entire stylus immersed in solvent.
Dirty spray caps and tips should be cleaned by soaking in
solvent and blow clean with air.

Description of Problem:
The machine stops in middle of cut and displays message
“Machine Paused, Press Zero, Next or Abort” on Touch
Screen.  When pressing NEXT on the keypad, the machine
will continue to cut where it left off.  This is typically caused
by an intermittent pause circuit, usually in thestop discs.
ev_8738cf22f376060ff6538b485e55:
Troubleshooting:
1.Check stop disc activation. The stop discs should not
activate by a slight touch or vibration. They should activate
only when moved by minimum pressure. Remove gantry
side cover. Check the pause plunger. Tighten the plunger
to increase activation pressure and loosen to decrease
activation pressure.

Place a finger on the upper left corner of the touch screen and, while holding it there, turn ON the main power switch on the back of the diagnostic control cabinet. Remove the finger after the “Power On Setup” screen appears. Use the left and right arrows to navigate to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2), then press Touch screen to begin calibrating. Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the cross; when the cross reappears in the lower right corner, press its center. Navigate to screen page 3 and select save and exit to complete calibration. The touch screen will restart in normal mode.
actions.name: Calibrate the touch screen

claim_evidence.quote: Touch screen calibration in required. Proceed as follows.
1) Power down the cutting system.
2) Place finger on the upper left corner of the touch screen as Shown. While holding finger on the screen, turn ON the main power switch located on the back of the diagnostic control cabinet.
3) Remove finger after the "Power On Setup" screen appears.
4) Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen to begin calibrating.
5) Using a paper clip or fine tip object, press the center of the cross as shown. The cross will reappear in the lower right corner. Press the center of the cross.
6) Navigate to screen page 3. Select save and exit to complete calibration.

solvent and blow clean with air.

Navigate to screen page 3 and select save and exit to complete calibration. The touch screen will restart in normal mode.

actions.description: Perform the stated touch screen calibration procedure and save and exit.
actions.instruction_text: Power down the cutting system. Place finger on the upper left corner of the touch screen as Shown. While holding finger on the screen, turn ON the main power switch located on the back of the diagnostic control cabinet. Remove finger after the "Power On Setup" screen appears. Using the left and right arrows to navigate, go to the Calibration Screen (screen page 2). Press Touch screen to begin calibrating. locator.quote:
Cleaning of Airbrush
The air brush stylus has been designed for minimum main-
tenance. The leather packing washers should be lubricated
once a month with light oil. Old packing washers cause
leakage of air or fluid. Flush clean solvent through the fluid
passage of the stylus and wipe off the outside with clean
solvent. Never leave the entire stylus immersed in solvent.
Dirty spray caps and tips should be cleaned by soaking in
solvent and blow clean with air.
